garage.line: And he's still jumping off the garage
stanza: Now, he's old and gray with a flour sack cape
Tied all around his head
And he's still jumping off the garage
And will be till he's dead
All these years, the people said
He was actin' like a kid
He did not know he could not fly
So he did

garage.line: In the basement flat, by the garages
garage.lineNext: Where the people dump their mattresses

garage.line: The people will flock to the garages
garage.linePrev: Ask the dead mystics for wisdom they don't trust
garage.lineNext: Stockpile cannisters of gasoline, tinned fish, and bandages

stanza: Shell of an engine, unexplained
Burst to fire engulfed in flames
Breathing exhaust, a heatwave mirage
Nothing to lose till everything's really gone
It's worse than death that life compressed
To fill a page in the Sunday paper
I had the shuddering thought:
"This was gonna make me late for work"

mirage.line: Signs you've lead the way to a mirage
stanza: Go, or go ahead and surprise me
Signs you've lead the way to a mirage
Go, or go ahead and just try me

massage.line: Give a box of candy or a foot massage
stanza: Later I come to find
Life is sweeter than Jewish wine
Give a box of candy or a foot massage
Some people don't take the time
